projects.title: KashNote
projects.description:
This is Ada Developer's Academy Capstone Project. Kash Note is an app where clients are able to gather their spendings into one platform and set a monthly budget goal. This app works with a Flask API where data is retrieved and stored.
Kash Note is developed by Ada Developer Academy's Cohort 17 Students - Katherine Otten Kim and Kelly Kang.

projects.title: Katherine's portfolio webpage
projects.description: This is my portfolio webpage. This webpage includes few mini projects that I did while study programming by myself and while study at Ada Developers Academy. I used HTML, CSS, Java, and JavaScript. I am going to update this webpage as I learn more about programming.
